positive_snippets: The hotel management is very polite and welcoming to customers. The food service is good. The hotel is conveniently located in a local area, allowing visitors to purchase items such as footwear and bags at reasonable prices.

Booked it directly as few of my friends visited this place earlier. It’s ideally situated, and near by to NLDS station. Very well connected with metro too. Rooms are nicely maintained and hygienic, prices are reasonable too. They do have a restaurant which is good, taste wise. Prices of food items are commensurate with quantity and quality. Enjoyed our stay there.

I stayed at Hotel Star Villas during my trip to Delhi for the Travis Scott concert.

The hotel was really nice... rooms were clean and comfortable. The location is super convenient, just a short distance from New Delhi Railway Station. I paid around ₹1500 for 24 hours, which felt like a pretty good deal for the area. Overall, a great budget stay with solid value for money!
negative_snippets: It's a very basic Budget accomodation hotel very near to New Delhi Railway station. They claim in booking apps as 4 star property whereas it's nothing more than a one/ two star Hotel. Most of the amenities and facilities as claimed are fake. The approach road to the hotel is so narrow that no car can enter. So you have to walk with ur luggage upto the hotel. Rooms are not well maintained, full of dust. Complementary breakst and food were also very average and limited for high price. They denied me my complementary Packed drinking water from 2nd day of four days stay in November 2025 and said you have buy your water whereas during my booking through Goibibo...it clearly mentioned to be included. Only positive was that the linens and towels were clean. Overall very bad experience. One should avoid such hotels unless you are bound to stay a night or two in Paharganj.

I had a very disappointing experience at Hotel Star Villa, Paharganj, New Delhi. I checked in on 29 October 2025 at 4 PM and checked out the next morning after completing my marketing work. The staff initially agreed to everything, but later they called and said that if I checked out after 1 PM, I’d have to pay extra charges. This kind of unprofessional behavior and sudden change of terms is unacceptable.

The management seems confused and lacks proper communication with guests. I will not recommend this hotel to anyone who expects honesty, professionalism, or respect for guests. There are plenty of better hotels nearby with more transparent and polite service.
